title: China Has a New $1.4 Trillion Plan to Overtake U.S. in Tech - Bloomberg
主要内容: China has announced a new $1.4 trillion plan aimed at overtaking the United States in key technologies, including artificial intelligence and wireless networks. The initiative reflects Beijing's strategic push to establish global leadership in critical technological sectors. The plan is part of a broader effort to enhance China's technological capabilities and reduce reliance on foreign technologies. This move is expected to have significant implications for the global technology landscape, potentially reshaping the competitive dynamics between major tech powers.
